requirements.invariant: Accept only the verified canonical nonempty assignment command bound to the runtime Account/Principal and preserve its exact stable OperationID without imposing a provider-specific ID format; Project and Business Inventory remain distinct exact scopes.

One transaction persists one canonical command-evidence row and one generic queued local operation. The localOnly `spike_item_space_assignment_commands` table uses operation ID as implicit text `id`; required text `account_id`, `actor_principal_id`, `contract_version`, `destination_space_id`, `scope_kind`, `expected_space_revision`, `items_json`, `fingerprint`, and `command_json`; nullable text `project_id`; required integer `accepted_at_ms`; and index `item_space_assignment_command_account` on `account_id`. It produces no ps_crud, and no Item/Space projection is written.

Persist and revalidate exact canonical command and envelope JSON, fingerprint, destination, scope, Space revision, stable Item order, every Item revision and the command's exact already-validated finite client time without adding provider admissibility. `scope_kind` is exactly `project` with required matching `project_id`, or `business_inventory` with null `project_id`. `items_json` is sorted-key canonical JSON `{schemaVersion:"item_space_assignment_items_v1",items:[{itemId,expectedRevision}]}` in command Item order with decimal-text revisions. Every revision uses canonical decimal text across UInt64. For a new admission only, provider-owned acceptance time must be finite, nonnegative, within Int64 after truncation toward zero to canonical epoch milliseconds, and round-trip exactly through the public Date snapshot representation; reject inadmissible provider time after the replay lookup and before either write. An exact replay uses persisted acceptance evidence and never consults the fresh provider clock.

Exact replay returns one existing receipt only after all operation and command evidence matches. Changed replay fails with OperationContractFailure.payloadMismatch; Account and Principal mismatch use the existing runtime scope failures; malformed rows fail with ItemSpaceAssignmentPowerSyncStoreFailure.malformedLocalEvidence; terminal rows fail closed without repair or mutation; concurrent same-ID calls converge on one durable outcome.

Cancellation before commit leaves no evidence; cancellation observed after atomic commit cannot erase accepted work. Non-destructive encrypted close/reopen retains command and operation rows. This slice exposes no deletion or repair API; later session-ending destructive cleanup and terminal reconciliation/retention policy remain authoritative for removal.

Expose one finite assignment submission and one assignment-specific operation watch through the existing Account runtime. The watch takes only an OperationID, queries exact operation ID plus constructor Account/Principal, emits only a fully validated queued snapshot with zero terminal fields, and otherwise fails closed; it invents no applying or terminal semantics. Cancellation and close join every provider/runtime watch; post-close admission refuses before database access.
The existing pending-work summary counts the accepted assignment exactly once through its generic queued operation and does not infer upload or remote durability.

No authoritative apply, Item/Space projection, upload connector, Postgres/RLS/Data API/Sync Stream/RPC, capability decision, app/MCP, hosted, Firebase, migration, production or cutover behavior advances. Raw transaction/read/write/watch failures map to localAcceptanceFailed without partial mutation or emission, while CancellationError passes through as control flow.

verification.expected: Project and Inventory commands persist exact scope, destination, canonical Item order, envelope/fingerprint and one queued operation atomically without Item/Space writes.

Space and every Item revision round-trip as canonical decimal text for zero, Int64.max boundary, Int64.max+1 and UInt64.max. Commands with negative and fractional-millisecond finite client times accepted by the frozen command contract persist/replay byte-identically, including a decoded-Date equality regression, with no redundant integer timestamp narrowing them. New admission truncates an ordinary positive fractional provider millisecond, admits exact high Date-round-trippable milliseconds, and rejects negative, nonfinite, beyond-Int64, or in-Int64-but-non-round-trippable time after lookup but before either write; every refusal stores no row. Exact replay succeeds without consulting an invalid fresh clock, and malformed stored non-round-trippable time fails closed.
Encrypted close/reopen restores byte-identical command and operation evidence and exactly one queued receipt.

An armed pre-database sentinel proves foreign Account and Principal submit refusal occurs before access, while a matching-scope control reaches it. Exact replay succeeds; changed command/rebound operation, either orphaned row, every independently tampered or null required command-table field, every malformed/contradictory operation field, non-queued state, non-null terminal field and unexpected result row fail with the frozen taxonomy and without repair or mutation.
Concurrent same-ID acceptance converges to one durable command/operation pair; conflicting payload has one winner and one fail-closed result.

Injected writeTransaction admission, existing-row read, first write and second write failures map exactly to ItemSpaceAssignmentFailure.localAcceptanceFailed; every write-path failure rolls back both rows. Injected pre-commit CancellationError passes through and stores nothing; cancellation observed after atomic commit preserves accepted evidence.
Valid evidence survives repeated encrypted reopen; partial/malformed rows never upgrade to accepted work.

Injected watch construction, query/read and iteration failures map to ItemSpaceAssignmentFailure.localAcceptanceFailed with no partial emission; CancellationError passes through.
